title: Perpendicular Bisector Practice Quiz
description: An interactive MCQ quiz with 12 mixed questions covering perpendicular bisector concepts. Questions span conceptual understanding, visual diagram interpretation, true/false, error detection, proof reasoning, and multi-select synthesis. Each question includes a progressive hint and detailed explanation upon submission. Canvas-rendered diagrams illustrate construction scenarios for visual questions.
teaching_notes: This quiz directly maps to the Figure it Out exercises from the textbook Chapter 6. Questions 1-2 cover standard construction (textbook intro), Questions 3-4 address different radii (Exercise Q1), Questions 5-6 test same-side arcs (Exercise Q2), Question 7 is error detection (Exercise Q3), Questions 8-9 test congruence proofs and 90° angle construction, Questions 10-11 cover equidistant property and Sulba-Sutra rope method, and Question 12 is a synthesis multi-select. The hint system scaffolds without giving away the answer.

tool_objectives.instructions_for_student: Answer questions about the standard perpendicular bisector construction method using equal-radius arcs.
Explore whether different radii can be used above and below the segment.
Determine if both arc pairs can be drawn on the same side of XY.
Identify errors in a construction where unequal radii are used within the same pair.
Apply congruence proofs, equidistant property, and synthesize all construction methods.

instructions_for_student: Complete 12 mixed questions about perpendicular bisector constructions! Questions include conceptual MCQs, diagram-based visual questions, true/false, error detection, and multi-select synthesis. Use hints if stuck, and read the explanations carefully after each answer.
generation_prompt: Create a perpendicular bisector practice quiz with 12 mixed MCQ questions. Include: Q1-2 on standard construction (conceptual + diagram), Q3-4 on different radii (true/false + diagram), Q5-6 on same-side arcs (MCQ + reasoning), Q7 on error detection (diagram with unequal radii in one pair), Q8 on congruence proof (SSS), Q9 on 90° angle construction, Q10 on equidistant property, Q11 on Sulba-Sutra rope method, Q12 as multi-select synthesis. Each question has 1 hint, detailed explanation, canvas diagram where applicable, and scoring with category breakdown.
